sloka: नमः पूर्वाय गिरये पश्चिमे गिरये नमः ।ज्योतिर्गणानां पतये दिनाधिपतये नमः ।। ६.१०७.१६ ।।
transliteration: namaḥ pūrvāya giraye paścime giraye namaḥ ।jyotirgaṇānāṁ pataye dinādhipataye namaḥ ।। 6.107.16 ।।

translations.english: "Hail to you, rising on the east mountain, setting in the west. Hail to the Lord of all luminaries.
